description: Welcome to the Coding Wolfpack! We are gathering the best hackers and coders in TRU to dominate this competition. Let's show the world the glory of our hackers at Thompson Rivers University!
summary: Mission Control is a Space Mission Design simulator. The goal is to simulate real world budgeting and physics constraints to missions and have the user learn what it takes to have missions succeed based upon the objective. The game has an option for multiplayer to simulate a team of engineers jointly making decisions. Three real world example missions are chosen and based on the difficulty, users can see what equipment is actually necessary to succeed and what real world budgeting constraints they have to consider.
details: The game starts with the player or players being able to choose from four engineering roles based on different positions in a space mission. They can then select among four budgeting difficulties from easy, which assumes an unlimited budget, to hard -simulation, which simulates real world budgeting constraints for NASA and CSA. When the player then selects instruments and equipment that permit a launch that aligns with the mission and budget selected, the simulation checks the result of whether the mission is successful or a failure, which will result in a video reflecting the result at the end of the game. The game's codebase is in gdscript. SI was used for debugging and for the video and photo generation.
